Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers.
Bottom line: the Knicks win 60 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 191 and 240 total points.

analyst.text: Portland come off an emotional night in Milwaukee, where Damian Lillard scored 33 on his return. They play again with no rest day, near the end of the road trip, without Deni Avdija (foot, possible return) and Ja Morant (hamstring). The defending champion Knicks have won three straight. Mike Brown is publicly backing the slumping Mikal Bridges as a starter. The angle leans slightly towards New York.
